limitations: The autonomous Matching worker is disabled by default to isolate intake consumer scaling; worker-enabled runs are a separate, confounded variant.
Intake latency is published-at to durable-round-created-at; it is not full workflow latency.
Broker replication is outside E03; these are application consumer replicas on one broker. Declared broker/application metrics are required.
Report-grade execution additionally requires a green G4 gate and the campaign analyzer.

auditor.scope: Independent read-only Matching authority for durable intake/dedup; pending work is retained with production execution metadata, not claimed as completed rides
